audit.whatIsWrong: The page sells Defiant Dance as a 'parry' for Akali's all-in ('Punish any all-in with W parry timed on her E return', 'W the burst, stun the exit').
audit.why: Irelia W reduces PHYSICAL damage during the charge; Akali's damage is magic. There is no parry in either kit's text.
audit.corrected: Tricky at 7/10 (48.68% over 2085 games). You survive by dodging and grounding, not by charging W through her burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] call Perfect Execution 'Akali's shroud ult', conflating W with R.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is W (20/19/18/17/16, 350 range, untargetable). Perfect Execution is R (120/90/60, 675 range, two dashes, the second executes). phases[4].side is already 'Akali' but its why described Irelia winning level 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Akali because Perfect Execution is a 120s double dash with an execute; your level 6 answer is the R wall cutting the second dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were never stated, and the packet flags that the page never names a single Akali ability.
audit.why: Shuriken Flip's re-cast is a dash — Flawless Duet's grounding denies it, and Vanguard's Edge terrain blocks her exit path. Assassin's Mark empowers her next auto once you leave the ring, which is the real burst tell (missingInteractions autoreset-burst-tell). Attacking or casting from Twilight Shroud reveals her, which is the window your stun exists for.
audit.corrected: Ground the flip, stun the reveal, wall the ult dash. Names used throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Twilight Shroud.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16 — 20s at rank 1, never 15. Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into both fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] told you to 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'. Akali has no heal or sustain anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: enemyKit lists no heal flag on any Akali ability; Grievous Wounds buys nothing here.
audit.corrected: Replaced with a magic-damage note pointing at Wit's End.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Defiant Dance has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 down to 16s — untargetable inside, so hold E and burst for the exit. - Shuriken Flip: 16s at rank 1; your E grounds the re-cast dash. - Perfect Execution: 120/90/60. She re-casts to execute, so never sit low inside its 675 range.
